chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I fully support Alice's idea of teaming up - I've finished the wiring in Cafeteria and I'm heading to Medbay next if anyone wants to join me for safety and task verification.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think it's great that we're all discussing our tasks and progress, but I'd like to ask Dave, can you confirm if you were alone in the Cafeteria when you finished the wiring, or was someone with you to verify that it was actually completed?

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to be direct - I just found Charlie's body in Cafeteria near the trash disposal, and I was literally doing tasks with them moments ago, so this kill must have happened very recently.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Given that I saw Charlie alive in Cafeteria just before going to Weapons, and Bob found the body so quickly after, I think we need to focus on who stayed behind in Cafeteria - Dave and Erin, can you both account for your exact movements during this time?

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Since we're focusing on the Cafeteria incident, I need to point out that Erin started questioning my task completion right before Charlie's body was found, which seems suspiciously like preemptive deflection.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I'd like to address Dave's accusation that I was trying to deflect attention by questioning his task completion - I was simply trying to clarify and make sure we're all on the same page, as I stated earlier.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to point out that Dave's behavior is highly suspicious - he was the only one who quickly tried to leave Cafeteria right after Charlie's death, and his immediate deflection of blame onto Erin when she asked a simple verification question seems like classic impostor tactics.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since Dave was so quick to leave Cafeteria and then deflect onto Erin when questioned, combined with being alone during wiring tasks, I strongly believe we should vote for Dave this round.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I wasn't alone during the wiring task - Bob literally confirmed earlier that he was in Cafeteria with me, Erin, and Charlie, so his sudden change in story about me being alone and suspicious seems like he's deliberately trying to frame me.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think we're getting sidetracked by Dave's attempts to deflect blame and create confusion, and we need to refocus on the fact that Charlie was killed in the Cafeteria while multiple people were present, so we should be looking for inconsistencies in the alibis of those who were in the room, rather than just targeting one person based on circumstantial evidence.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to be clear - Dave is misrepresenting what I said: while we were all initially in Cafeteria together, the suspicious part is that he announced finishing his task and wanting to leave right before Charlie's body was found.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I think it's crucial to point out that Dave's attempt to twist Bob's words about who was present during tasks, combined with his defensive behavior and changing story about Medbay and wiring tasks, strongly suggests he's the impostor who killed Charlie.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Since Bob's story keeps changing about whether I was alone or with the group in Cafeteria, and he conveniently "found" Charlie's body right after supposedly doing tasks together, I think we need to seriously consider that Bob is the impostor trying to frame me.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think it's interesting that Bob is trying to frame Dave, but his own alibi is shaky - he was in the cafeteria with Charlie moments before their body was found, and he's the one who "discovered" the body.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to emphasize that finding Charlie's body quickly isn't suspicious - I was literally doing the same trash task with them, while Dave was the one who announced leaving Cafeteria right before the kill happened.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I need to emphasize that Dave's story has changed multiple times - first saying he was heading to Medbay, then claiming he wasn't alone during wiring, and now trying to cast doubt on Bob who has been consistently transparent about his movements and actions.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I can confirm I was in cafeteria with Erin, Dave, and Charlie completing tasks, and I saw Alice head towards Weapons, but I haven't checked life support or navigation yet.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can vouch for Bob's statement - I did head to Weapons to work on the targeting system calibration, and I'd feel safer if someone wanted to team up with me to complete tasks together.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I fully support Alice's idea of teaming up - I've finished the wiring in Cafeteria and I'm heading to Medbay next if anyone wants to join me for safety and task verification.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think it's great that we're all discussing our tasks and progress, but I'd like to ask Dave, can you confirm if you were alone in the Cafeteria when you finished the wiring, or was someone with you to verify that it was actually completed?

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to be direct - I just found Charlie's body in Cafeteria near the trash disposal, and I was literally doing tasks with them moments ago, so this kill must have happened very recently.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Given that I saw Charlie alive in Cafeteria just before going to Weapons, and Bob found the body so quickly after, I think we need to focus on who stayed behind in Cafeteria - Dave and Erin, can you both account for your exact movements during this time?

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Since we're focusing on the Cafeteria incident, I need to point out that Erin started questioning my task completion right before Charlie's body was found, which seems suspiciously like preemptive deflection.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I'd like to address Dave's accusation that I was trying to deflect attention by questioning his task completion - I was simply trying to clarify and make sure we're all on the same page, as I stated earlier.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to point out that Dave's behavior is highly suspicious - he was the only one who quickly tried to leave Cafeteria right after Charlie's death, and his immediate deflection of blame onto Erin when she asked a simple verification question seems like classic impostor tactics.
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since Dave was so quick to leave Cafeteria and then deflect onto Erin when questioned, combined with being alone during wiring tasks, I strongly believe we should vote for Dave this round.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I wasn't alone during the wiring task - Bob literally confirmed earlier that he was in Cafeteria with me, Erin, and Charlie, so his sudden change in story about me being alone and suspicious seems like he's deliberately trying to frame me.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think we're getting sidetracked by Dave's attempts to deflect blame and create confusion, and we need to refocus on the fact that Charlie was killed in the Cafeteria while multiple people were present, so we should be looking for inconsistencies in the alibis of those who were in the room, rather than just targeting one person based on circumstantial evidence.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to be clear - Dave is misrepresenting what I said: while we were all initially in Cafeteria together, the suspicious part is that he announced finishing his task and wanting to leave right before Charlie's body was found.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I think it's crucial to point out that Dave's attempt to twist Bob's words about who was present during tasks, combined with his defensive behavior and changing story about Medbay and wiring tasks, strongly suggests he's the impostor who killed Charlie.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Since Bob's story keeps changing about whether I was alone or with the group in Cafeteria, and he conveniently "found" Charlie's body right after supposedly doing tasks together, I think we need to seriously consider that Bob is the impostor trying to frame me.

chat: Discussion: [Erin]: I think it's interesting that Bob is trying to frame Dave, but his own alibi is shaky - he was in the cafeteria with Charlie moments before their body was found, and he's the one who "discovered" the body.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I need to emphasize that finding Charlie's body quickly isn't suspicious - I was literally doing the same trash task with them, while Dave was the one who announced leaving Cafeteria right before the kill happened.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I need to emphasize that Dave's story has changed multiple times - first saying he was heading to Medbay, then claiming he wasn't alone during wiring, and now trying to cast doubt on Bob who has been consistently transparent about his movements and actions.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I've been completely consistent about being in a group during the wiring task, and it's telling that Bob keeps changing his story about whether I was alone or with others while desperately trying to paint my pre-planned Medbay announcement as suspicious.
